# herdr dispatch & grouping restore

Restore the flag-driven behaviour in herdr: review-queue ordering, auto-dispatch exclusion, metadata parity and the help-screen legend.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `inReviewBucket` (packages/herdr/src/grouping.ts) restored to 6 buckets with bucket 1 = `needsProducerReview === true`; keeps the shared audit-freshness predicate.
- [ ] Fetcher/downtime-worker `select*`/`classifyItemForDispatch` exclude `needsProducerReview === true` items from auto-dispatch again, at every tier.
- [ ] `index.ts`, `pane-lifecycle.ts`, `pane-close*.ts`, `stalled-work.ts`, `settings.ts` carry/use the flag again.
- [ ] Metadata panel renders a `Producer Review` row (icon + label) and the help-screen `ICON_LEGEND` restores the `producer-review` category; the legend drift guard passes.
- [ ] `tests/grouping-utility.test.ts`, `packages/herdr/src/grouping.test.ts`, `tests/herdr/icons.test.ts` (actions + metadata row) pass.

## Key Files

- `packages/herdr/src/grouping.ts`, `fetcher.ts`, `downtime-worker.ts`, `index.ts`, `pane-lifecycle.ts`, `pane-close*.ts`, `stalled-work.ts`, `settings.ts`, `worklist.ts`
- `packages/shared/src/icons.ts` (ICON_LEGEND, iconLegendGlyphs)

## Deliverables

Restored flag-driven dispatch/grouping/metadata/legend, with tests.

data.author: Map
data.comment:
## Intake blocked — producer input required

The seed brief ("Whenever the selection list in herdr gets focus it should refresh the view") overlaps almost entirely with **already-completed** work. Research summary:

- **Tab-level hidden→visible refresh is implemented**: `WL-0MSBVS4AS006ZQEZ` (immediate refresh on tab regain focus) plus the `pane_focused` event path in `WL-0MSHB7DHO004RHBJ` / `WL-0MSIG3IO7009RL03`, with a tab-level `resume-poll` fallback. Code: `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts` (`onPaneFocused` → `doRefresh(true)`; `resume-poll` task).
- **Tab-focus visibility gating is implemented**: `WL-0MSJNJPRM009RM35` / `WL-0MSKUAT5D00443GA` (`visibility.ts` — `HERDR_TAB_ID` + `herdr tab get` → `result.tab.focused`).

So the requested capability appears to already exist. I need to know the **residual gap** before drafting a brief.

### Q1 — Which focus transition is actually in scope?

- **A.** Tab regains focus (hidden → visible) — already implemented and verified.
- **B.** The list pane regains **keyboard** focus inside an **already-visible** tab (multi-pane split: click / focus the list pane while the tab stayed focused). Today this relies on the `pane_focused` event; the `resume-poll` fallback is tab-level only, so if events are unavailable no refresh occurs.
- **C.** Both, including the reliability of the event path (see Q3).

**Recommended:** **B** — because A is already shipped; the only plausible residual gap is pane-level focus within a visible tab when the event path is not delivering.

### Q2 — Is this a defect report or a net-new requirement?

- **A.** Bug — the list was observed stale after focusing it (please attach a repro: exact key/combo or mouse action, single- vs multi-pane tab, was the tab already focused?).
- **B.** Requirement — codify "refresh on focus" (may be satisfied by the completed items above; then close/relate rather than re-implement).
- **C.** Duplicate/obsolete — close this item.

**Recommended:** **A with a repro** — since the implementation exists, a concrete repro is the only way to identify the residual gap. If no repro exists, **B** with an explicit residual-gap statement is next best.

### Q3 — Event-subscription reliability (evidence of a possible real defect)

`~/.config/herdr/herdr-server.log` shows `events.subscribe` requests completing with `outcome="stream_closed"` and reconnecting on an ~10 s cadence (`sub-100` … `sub-115` at 2026-10-16T07:15–07:17, matching `MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS = 10_000` in `packages/herdr/src/events.ts`). If the events stream keeps closing, `pane_focused` events never arrive reliably and only the tab-level `resume-poll` fallback remains — which would exactly explain "the list does not refresh when I focus it".

- **A.** Yes — include diagnosing/fixing the `stream_closed` reconnect loop in this work item.
- **B.** No — that is a separate defect (I will create a child work item for it).
- **C.** Unknown/not applicable.

**Recommended:** **A** — the log evidence points at the event path as the likely root cause, and it is squarely within "refresh on focus".

---

_Answer by replying on this work item; I will resume intake once the scope is clarified._ Research performed against `packages/herdr/src/{worklist,visibility,events}.ts` and the related completed items listed above.
